title: The completed first square for the normalized Chern adjunct

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: Let l be prime and Y a Noetherian scheme such that P=ProjectiveLine Y is Noetherian, with specified DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y and l P. Let s:UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport] and p:NormalizedAdjunctPair l Y s [def-diagonal-uniformizer-adjunct-conditions]. Write uP for the completed realization single-unit isomorphism. Realization of p.c followed by the completed direct-image square and the shifted positive-line endpoint equals completedY.singleUnit followed by coefficientUnitPush for s.zl.Rq and its direct image of uP.inv, realization(p.z), and completedP.shiftedLine. Only the first completed realization appears; the integral and quotient scalar mates and finite realization do not occur. All coefficient-unit arrows are the explicit constructions [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push].

proof.text: Let b be the degree-zero image of completedPushUnit followed by the specified universal single-object derived comparison. The full derived-unit normalization, evaluated on the single complex, and naturality of exact single comparisons give its realization square. completed_ordinary_unit identifies its ordinary coefficient component with coefficientUnitPush.

The identity projective model makes the model Picard pullback equal O(1). Expand homEquiv as adjunction unit followed by pushforward. Naturality of varying factors systemChern as the coefficient unit-system arrow followed by pushforward of firstChern. The existing finite-push unit seed, before any finite evaluation, identifies the restriction of b after the coefficient cone and limit square with that coefficient unit-system arrow.

Apply completed scalar restriction to c and b followed by Rc.map z. The line comparison and hence sourceMap are isomorphisms. After postcomposing with sourceMap, naturality of the completed and limit squares and local_normalized identify the second arrow with the expression in adjunct_normalized, using the seed from the preceding step. The unit and the line are complete; the latter is locally free of rank one, since the normalized data imply l invertible on Y and its projective line. Shifts and right adjoints preserve completeness by adjunction, so Rc of the shifted line is complete. Full faithfulness of restriction on complete objects now identifies c with b followed by Rc.map z.

Apply completed realization to the preceding equality, use naturality of q_square.derived, and substitute the realization square for b. Cancel the realized unit isomorphism and reassociate. This yields exactly the stated completed adjunct square, with all endpoints unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_adjunct_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    (s : UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y) (p : NormalizedAdjunctPair l Y s) :
    let uP := (s.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso s.completedP.unitIso
    s.completedY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map p.c ≫
        (s.q_square.derived.iso.hom.app _ ≫
          s.zl.Rq.R.map (s.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))) =
      s.completedY.singleUnit l Y ≫
        (coefficientUnitPush _ Y s.zl.Rq ≫ s.zl.Rq.R.map
          ((uP.inv ≫ s.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map p.z) ≫
            s.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)))
